question: What distinction between kinds of linguistic utterances is being asserted as arising in varied forms under the stated condition?
premises: Languages appear in a variety of forms.
Some utterances fall into the category of the heard.
Some utterances fall into the category of the unheard.
inference: Both heard and unheard utterances occur among languages of varied forms.
uncertainties: The source of this distinction is not specified by the verse.
plain_english: Languages of varied forms indeed arise, both heard and unheard.
